learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected Only a north pole and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Snapped middle: north half recorded N plus S and halves pulled together. Turned right half: pushed apart. Turn it back restored pulled together. Snapped each half again: four pieces, each N plus S, and reveal enabled.
observations.reveal: Corrected to both poles, referenced new cut-face poles, repulsion when turned and both poles in quarters. Explained aligned tiny atomic magnets and absence of observed lone north poles.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 by 936 screenshots inspected. Half magnets and compass markers showed S and N at break. Four-quarter reveal displayed labeled poles and internal arrows with a persistent Seen history; all explanation text fit. Despite turn-back action, final right-quarter arrows were opposite left-quarter arrows; state consistency was not further investigated.

observations.blinding: No source, builder notes or other reviews inspected.
